notes: Quick summary: Starlit builds quantum-resistant key vaults for regulated customers. Primary constraint = customer-managed keys (no vendor-managed keys). Strong preference for HSM-backed CMEK across cloud artifacts and model encryption. Wants a Private (VPC) deployment; may go hybrid for air-gapped customers. CTO explicitly: "We cannot allow vendor KEK in your control plane — keys must be in our KMS/HSM." Needs evidence of audit logging (immutable), key usage telemetry, ability to rotate without downtime, and exportable audit trails for compliance audits.

use_case_summary: Primary: run customer-sensitive inference workloads inside customer VPC with per-tenant cryptographic controls. They will serve embeddings + reranking for financial customers. Need tight PII/data residency controls, and KMS integration for: model artifact encryption, KV cache encryption, and encryption of logs/outputs at rest. Secondary: audit-grade key usage reporting and ability to rotate keys zero-downtime.
requirements_summary: Must-haves: 1) Support for customer-managed keys (CMEK) across AWS KMS, Azure Key Vault (Managed HSM), GCP KMS; 2) BYOK import path documented and tested; 3) Hardware-backed keys (HSM/CloudHSM/Thales) or validated HSM provider; 4) Envelope encryption + key wrapping in Redwood Private control plane but with KEK never accessible by Redwood; 5) Immutable, exportable audit logs (CloudTrail + SIEM forwarding) and retention controls; 6) Data residency controls (ability to pin model artifacts and inference traffic to specific regions); 7) SSO/SAML + granular RBAC for key access; 8) FIPS 140-2/3 evidence for HSMs where required.

acceptance_criteria: Customer-managed keys enforced: Redwood cannot read KEK; only use wrapped DEKs provided via KMS APIs
Key rotation test: rotate CMEK with <60s perceived downtime for inference traffic
Audit log completeness: every KMS operation (Encrypt/Decrypt/GenerateDataKey/Sign) appears in customer SIEM within 2 minutes
BYOK import verification: demonstrate successful key import for Azure and GCP (documentation + runbook)
HSM validation: supply FIPS 140-2/3 certs or equivalent attestation for chosen HSM provider
Data residency: deployment pinned in requested regions; no cross-region model fallback unless explicitly allowed
